title: CAR-003 Pre-Execution Binding Records
description: CAR-003-additive. The Codex twin publishes no assignment schema, so the Claude side authors one. A oneOf over three pre-execution binding records: the Partition Registry Entry (FR-013), the Calibration Protocol (FR-037), and the Comparison Set / Assignment (FR-037). Making these schema-enforced is what lets the bindings-exist-before-execution invariant be validated rather than assumed.

partitionRegistryEntry.description: FR-013: disjointness is enforced at the objective level. An objective identifier appearing in more than one registered partition's objective set fails closed with failure_plane=partition.

objective_set_digest.description: FR-033: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization of the deduplicated, lexicographically sorted objective_ids array. Pinning the preimage is what makes two partitions listing the same objectives in different orders collide detectably.

allOf.description: FR-013: calibration MUST always carry qualification_eligible=false.

calibrationProtocol.description: FR-037: carries no margins, sample sizes, or terminal thresholds. This is what breaks the circular dependency in which a calibration pair would otherwise have to bind an analysis plan that only freezes after calibration.

comparisonSetAssignment.description: FR-037: every binding exists before execution. Refreshes create additive invalidations instead of rebinding, and each rerun creates new paired assignments linked to the original comparison set.

environment_contract.description: FR-051: the environment pinned before execution. Every value reuses a field the frozen CAR-002 routeResolution or runtimeCapabilitySnapshot already carries; none is re-coined here. The run's observed environment is compared against this record, and divergence blocks outcome scoring with failure_plane=treatment and the existing closed treatment_infrastructure_failure code.

fast_mode_state.description: FR-051: frozen off for every scored attempt. Distinct from FR-005, which governs admission rather than what is running.

parent_session_model.description: FR-051: pinned because a subagent declaring no model inherits the parent session's.

env_override_proof_complete.description: FR-039: true only when all eight members of the frozen unsetProof record are present. A single completeness boolean names no closed override surface, so this asserts the enumeration was satisfied rather than substituting for it.

authentication_mode.description: FR-042: the expected mode, compared against the run's observed mode reached through the snapshot binding. Subscription is the supported scored path; no supported path requires an API key.

stratum_assignment.description: FR-052: the workload stratum this pair belongs to, fixed in the pre-execution binding record alongside every other assignment field. Recording membership here is what makes 'membership was fixed before either arm ran' provable at replay rather than asserted. Stratum membership is a design-time allocation variable, so it must be derived from characteristics known before treatment, exactly as randomization strata in a controlled trial are built from prognostic baseline covariates rather than from observed results.

stratum_id.description: MUST resolve to a stratum registered in the bound analysis plan's workload manifest, or to the manifest's unknown-stratum policy.

membership_basis.description: FR-052: the closed set of task and protocol characteristics membership may be derived from. Every member is a field the role-corpus contract already binds before execution, so no new pre-execution vocabulary is coined. An empty basis is not permitted, because a stratum assignment with no stated basis is indistinguishable from one chosen after the fact.

derived_from_realized_outcomes.description: FR-052: pinned false. Realized duration, turns, tokens, retries, and compactions are post-treatment quantities; stratifying on them conditions the comparison on an outcome of the treatment and induces selection bias, and would additionally let the powered long-horizon stratum be populated after results are visible.

invalidations.description: FR-041: additive invalidation markers. A bound pair is marked invalidated, never rebound.

allOf.description: FR-037: qualification-eligible pairs bind the frozen analysis plan.

FR-037: every qualification-ineligible pair binds the versioned calibration protocol instead, because the analysis plan does not yet exist. Keyed on qualification_eligible rather than partition_type so the two branches are exhaustive — keying on partition_type=calibration alone would leave a non-calibration ineligible partition bound to neither artifact, failing open.
